narrative.overview: WKND reads as an outdoor-travel magazine built from stock AEM Core Components: full-bleed landscape photography, a quiet serif (Asar) for titles, a humanist sans (Source Sans Pro) for everything else, and one flat signal yellow reserved for action and for the short rule under section titles. Surfaces are flat and square; depth comes from photography and from #ebebeb panels, not shadows. The same chrome — fixed white header with an uppercase nav and a dark #202020 footer band — frames all 65 pages; only the language toggle (flag + locale code), a Canada-only footer note, and the stripped-down coming-soon locale homes vary it.
keyCharacteristics: flat and square (radius 0 everywhere except dots and avatars)
Asar titles over Source Sans Pro body
photography first; captions and descriptions in muted grey
no responsive type scaling (same sizes at 360 and 1440)

rules.name: Yellow Means Act
rules.body: #ffea00 fills only calls to action, the active nav item and hover states, and draws the 84px underline rule; it never colours body text.

rules.name: Square Corners
rules.body: Buttons, cards, panels, images and tabs are square; circles appear only on carousel dots and people (avatars).

rules.name: Serif For Titles Only
rules.body: Asar 400 is used for h1–h3 and pull quotes; h4–h6, labels and all running text are Source Sans Pro.

rules.name: Flat By Default
rules.body: No drop shadows on content; the only shadow is the inset edge of the mobile navigation drawer.

dos: Do keep #ffea00 for actions, active states and the title underline.
Do keep photography full-bleed and square-cornered.
Do keep Asar 400 for titles and Source Sans Pro for everything else.
Do keep running text at 18px with the 45px (2.5) line-height.
donts: Don't add radius, gradients or shadows to content components — the system is flat and square.
Don't use yellow for body text or large background fields.
Don't introduce a third typeface (the Arial on FAQ accordion buttons is a UA default leak, not a brand face).
